title: skills-sync.local.json
description: This machine's answers to skills-sync, kept beside the committed config and gitignored: which harnesses to sync, whether to link the user folders, which projects and how, which WSL distros, skills an earlier run found gone upstream, how links are made, the user folders' form on harnesses with plugins, and the plugins the tool installed. Written by the tool after every run; --ask prompts again.

agents.description: Harness ids to sync (claude-code, codex, goose, hermes).

global.description: Link every skill into each harness's user skills folder.

dev.description: The folder whose git repositories are offered as projects.

projects.description: Project folder names under dev that get the skills.

mode.description: How projects get their skills: links hidden from git, or committed copies.

wsl.description: WSL distro names whose user folders are synced too (Windows).

unavailable.description: Selected skills an earlier refresh or restore could not find upstream; not looked for again until --retry.

links.description: auto: a directory symlink, or a junction when Windows refuses one. symlink or junction: that kind only (--symlinks, --junctions).

form.description: plugin: harnesses with plugin commands (Claude Code, Codex) get the library's built plugins, and the skills those carry get no loose link there. links: one loose link per skill everywhere, and the plugins the tool installed are uninstalled. Written only when --plugins or --links chose it; absent means the default (plugin, links in a cloud session).

plugins.description: What the tool installed through each harness's own plugin commands, keyed by the harness's config folder (so a WSL distro's harnesses are told apart from Windows'): rollback and unlink remove only these.

marketplace.description: The marketplace the tool registered (the library folder), when it did.

revisions.description: Verified package sha256 per owned plugin. Tracks cache changes independently of the displayed semantic version.
